checks.reason: Re-derived both genuine variance directions: fixing w and summing over the E-orthonormal family {e_k} gives, by Parseval in E and E:wave-input-variance, sum_{j<=N}||A_j(I)^{*,E}w||_E^2 = E||X_N(I)^{*,E}w||_E^2 <= b_I||w||_{E_{s-gamma}}^2; fixing z and summing over {e_k} gives, by E:wave-output-variance, sum_j||A_j(I)z||_E^2 <= b_I||z||_{E_{s-gamma}}^2. The two directions are therefore distinct and both used, not derived from one variance. Extension to full E_{s-gamma} uses the gain-one forward map and its E_s adjoint at index r=s+gamma-1, valid because gamma<1 (E_{s+1-gamma} and E_{s-gamma+1} embed into E_s); the finite-sum quadratic is continuous, so density carries the same b_I without summing j-dependent constants. Transport by J_0 and ||z||_{E_{s-gamma}}=||D_gamma J_0 z||_{H_0} give the two E:driver-two-variances quadratic inequalities. Localizations follow from E:driver-actual-localization, with no self-adjointness or projection property of P_chi used. Column expansions m and n use first-chaos completeness and independence of g_j=W(f_j), plus the Schwartz-to-E_{s-gamma} extension; the adjoint column n=sum g_j A_j^{*,E}z is consistent with <z,A_j^*w>_E=<A_j z,w>_E. No single-variance shortcut, law-only identification, or positivity assumption on P_chi is present.

The finite families a_j satisfy P:localized-finite-variance and C:finite-gaussian-operators because both localizations and both weighted variances were proved in PROOF088; hence coefficients are compact and finite Gaussian sums satisfy E:driver-fixed-schatten uniformly in N. Tail decay is exactly the two-trace average: L:driver-dominated-tails converts strongly vanishing positive tails into Tr T_out,N^{q/2}->0 and Tr T_in,N^{q/2}->0 (via eigenvalue domination, not operator-power monotonicity), and L:driver-gaussian-tail-average applied to Y_{N,M}=sum_{j=N+1}^M g_j A_j(I) gives sup_{M>N} E||Y_{N,M}||_{S_q}^q -> 0, which is genuine Lq(B(E)) Cauchy, not merely a uniform moment bound. The limit is on the original probability space through the separable span F_I and the Tonelli almost-sure convergent subsequence; compactness is inherited from the norm-closed compact operators. Each requested p uses an admissible even q>=p selected separately (no fixed-q shortcut). Fixed Schwartz rows are the actual raw forms in L2 on the same W, and long intervals add exactly via raw endpoint nullity from E:driver-test-continuity; the Schatten conclusion is explicitly fixed-interval at admissible even indices, not a Schatten-valued path. The only qualifications are the index condition q gamma>d and K_chi dependence on fixed R,T, both of which are stated.

The Young construction is applied to A and A^rho through P:constant-young-linear (local contraction, global growth, local Lipschitz dependence into the uniform time-triangle norm). Convergence in probability is obtained by restricting to the driver ball of radius K, where local Lipschitz constant L_K applies, and using Markov plus the uniform square-exponential driver bounds H_0 from P:constant-phase-driver; no independence of raw/source/residual drivers is assumed. The probability-to-Lp passage uses nu=1/theta<2, the elementary bound r C_T(1+x)^nu <= c x^2 + C_{r,c}, and the split E V^p <= eps^p + (E V^{2p})^{1/2} P(V>eps)^{1/2}, after first producing uniform 2p moments; this is valid and does not require operator-norm continuity of the free group. The Banach target is correct: U_{A^rho}->U_A in C(Delta_T;B(F)) with uniform triangle norm, and the physical flows are placed in a bounded-family space via the bounded-linear conjugation map P(t,s)=S_F(t)U(t,s)S_F(-s) with bound at most C_T^2, preserving measurability and finite moments without any norm continuity of S_F. The constant-coordinate block is read from pi_C U_A=pi_C together with J_t J_{-s}=J_{t-s}, and difference from free flow has range in iE because (U_A-I)F subset iE and S_F(t)iE=iE.

O_phi(e,c)=<e_1,phi>+c_1 is bounded by Sobolev duality with norm <= (||phi||_{H^{-1/2}}^2+1)^{1/2}; it tests the displacement pairing together with the constant displacement coordinate and takes no point trace of an H^{1/2} state. At each fixed rho, L:constant-source-solution identifies the displacement distribution of P_{A^rho}(t,0)e_0 with the ordinary source solution u_rho^m, so testing by phi with integral one gives the almost-sure identity with C_phi. The proof then verifies C_phi equals the Bochner L2 average B_phi from P:masked-source-moments by scalar Fubini (E∫|phi u_rho^m| <= Q_t||phi||_1) and by the continuous functional V->E[Xi V] argument with Xi=sign(B-C), so B_phi=C_phi a.s. tested-observable convergence follows from PROOF108: ||B_phi-Z_m||_{Lp} <= ||O_phi|| ||e_0|| ||P_{A^rho}-P_A||_{inf} in Lp -> 0, discharging the L2 premise of P:masked-canonical-transfer at the same fixed mask, horizon, original covariance and observable; since phi>=0 with integral one, E|Z_m|^2 <= E|u(t,0)|^2. All limits are at fixed mask and horizon before time asymptotics.

j_delta is a nonnegative continuous functional of the whole tuple (everywhere-defined Young map, fixed-time bounded free groups, finite product, bounded O_phi), so P:raw-block-gaussian-law applies directly to the raw Young products with the single original slow variable Z=W(Ψ) and variance v=Var Z; the identity is E U^2 = E[e^{-Z/sqrt(delta)-v/(2delta)} Y^2] with X+H the exact deterministic translate, keeping the quadratic cost at half the original variance, and it requires no prior integrability of j_delta. The masked comparison is performed at the actual amplitude Gamma_delta=g_delta^2 Gamma via W'=g_delta W_fast, the nth source chain acquiring g_delta^n. Source product convergence is unweighted (no tilted density): for fixed delta,N the factors F_{m,rho} converge in every finite Lq with uniformly bounded norm moments, and the telescoping product estimate ||product difference||_{L2} <= n||C||_{L^{4n}}^n||e||_{L^4} -> 0 uses exponents 4n and 4; this is a fixed-delta source limit, not a uniform-in-N claim. L:constant-source-solution plus P:masked-source-moments and P:masked-canonical-transfer give E U^2 <= E|u_{Gamma_delta}(L,0)|^2, and the law chain g_delta Y_fast(u)=sqrt(delta)Y(delta u) with fast cutoff eta/delta matches E:exact-fast-equation; L:exact-canonical-scaling then gives the equality of moments E|V_delta(1,0)|^2 = E|u(T,0)|^2 at delta=T^{-kappa} (V_delta(1,0) has the law of u(T,0)).

For fixed e_rate>0 the cone constants, including an integer B(e_rate), are fixed before the delta limit; no B=B(delta) occurs. With p>2/(1-a) and gamma_p=p(1-a)/2-1>0, the union bound over N+1<=2/delta blocks gives P(M_delta>eta) <= A_p eta^{-p} delta^{gamma_p} without any block independence, and the single Z=W(Ψ) is controlled separately by Chebyshev E Z^2=v, so p_delta>=1-A_p eta^{-p} delta^{gamma_p}-v delta^{1/2}->1. The deterministic Young tolerance L_B(M_delta+delta) on the fixed ball of radius H_0+1 converts M_delta<=eta into E_{op,delta}<=epsilon_op for small delta, with all constants fixed. On the common event E_delta, the indexed cone with terminal remainder tau gives Y_{delta,B}>0 and delta log Y >= delta log c_* + delta(N-1)log(1-rho) + delta B sum_{m<N} lambda_{s_m} + delta tau lambda_{s_N}; the last terms are the left Riemann sum of I_R on all of [0,1] with mesh delta B and error at most C_lambda delta B, so Y_{delta,B} >= exp((I_R-e_rate)/delta). Restricting the nonnegative Gaussian identity to E_delta, where -Z/sqrt(delta) >= -delta^{-3/4}, gives E|u(T,0)|^2 >= p_delta exp((2I_R-2e_rate-v/2)/delta - delta^{-3/4}); multiplying the log by delta yields 2I_R-2e_rate-v/2 - delta^{1/4} + delta log p_delta with delta log p_delta -> 0 and delta^{1/4}->0. The bijection delta=T^{-kappa} completes the continuous-time liminf, e_rate is sent to zero after each fixed-B argument, and spatial translation invariance replaces 0 by any fixed x. This makes exactly one union bound, with no independence of blocks or of Z, and keeps all remainder blocks including tau.

The Unit-A question is satisfied: PROOF088 uses the two distinct Hilbert-Bessel directions E:wave-input-variance and E:wave-output-variance with first-chaos completeness, and PROOF091 turns those both-variance bounds plus compact tail-trace averaging into actual same-W fixed-interval Lp(B(E)) convergence with each p getting its own admissible even q, compactness and joint Gaussianity on the original space, and exact raw row/additivity with no one-variance shortcut, no law-only identification and no fixed-q inference of all moments.

The Unit-B question is satisfied: PROOF108 passes from retaining-source driver convergence and square-exponential driver norms to Young-flow convergence in probability and then in every finite Lp of the uniform time-triangle norm, using the bounded-conjugation physical-flow target and avoiding operator-norm continuity of the free group; PROOF110 converts that into convergence of the actual Bochner tested observable O_phi, identifying the pathwise scalar average with the Bochner average by Fubini and discharging the masked-transfer premise without any point trace.

The Unit-C question is satisfied: PROOF125 applies the exact single-Z Gaussian half-action identity directly to raw Young products and proves actual-amplitude masked comparison through unweighted retaining-source product convergence, and PROOF126 derives the full continuous-time original lower rate at the half cost from one common high-probability event, a single-Chebyshev bound for Z, the left Riemann sum over [0,1] including the terminal tau remainder, and iterated fixed-B-then-delta limits. The Gaussian cost is exactly v/2 (not doubled or lost), the union bound is used without independence, and fixed-source/mask/horizon limits are separated from the large-time limit.

Independently checked. (1) For d=1, alpha=1, a=1/2, gamma=1/4, theta=9/16, eta=5/8, beta=11/16, q0=32: gamma<min(1/2,(2-alpha)/2), theta<beta<min(1-a/2,(3-a-alpha)/2)=3/4, theta<eta<beta, q0 gamma=8>1, and delta0=beta-eta-1/q0=1/32>0; for p=1,33,100 the selected q=32,34,100 are admissible even integers with q gamma>1, q>=p and q<=p+q0+2<= (q0+3)p, so per-p selection is essential and one fixed q does not cover all Lp. (2) With A1=[[1,1],[0,0]], A2=[[0,0],[1,0]]: V_out=A1A1^T+A2A2^T=diag(2,1), V_in=A1^T A1+A2^T A2=[[2,1],[1,1]] (they differ); Tr V_out^2=5, Tr V_in^2=7, and E Tr((X^T X)^2)=17 (computed as E[(g1^2+g2^2)^2]+3E[g1^4]=8+9=17), which is bounded by the q=4 two-variance average bound (p-1)^{p/2}(Tr V_out^{p/2}+Tr V_in^{p/2})/2=9*(5+7)/2=54; this finite example does not prove infinite tails or arbitrary power-map positivity. (3) The product bound n*C^n*e with L2 exponents 4n and 4 matches PROOF125's fixed-delta source-product convergence and is not uniform in N. (4) For Z~N(0,v) with s=1/sqrt(delta) and H=v/sqrt(delta), E j(Z)=E[e^{-sZ-s^2v/2} j(Z+H)] holds for j(x)=x and j(x)=x^2 keeping the single original v. (5) At a=1/2,p=6, gamma_p=1/2, the union/Chebyshev event gives p_delta->1, delta log p_delta->0, delta*delta^{-3/4}=delta^{1/4}->0, and AN126 retains the tau remainder and N/tau edge cases with no independence; these are finite-parameter checks, not infinite-tail proofs, and all fit the actual infinite-dimensional hypotheses applied in the six bodies.
